name: Ice Cream Man

specialAbility.name: Brain Freeze
specialAbility.description: Ice Cream Man launches a giant scoop of the coldest ice cream ever, freezing the enemy truck in its tracks!

lore: What happens when an ice cream truck gets monster truck tires and a turbo engine? You get Ice Cream Man! This pink-and-white smasher still plays that jingly music, but now it crushes cars instead of selling popsicles. One blast of its Brain Freeze and your truck is stuck like a Popsicle!
